nlnet.project_description: JAEGER: BCC Re-Investigation forensic layer. Evidence provenance, entity resolution, claim-to-source citation, disclosure gate (PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json). NOT the therapeutic agent.
nlnet.abstract: JAEGER keeps investigation claims tied to source documents via evidence provenance, entity resolution, and a disclosure gate.
nlnet.equipment_justification: Hyper-Edge DEV: RTX 4090 + 128GB DDR5 + 4TB NVMe for entity resolution and provenance pipeline.
nlnet.use: Investigators use JAEGER to tie claims to documents and enforce disclosure gate.
nlnet.comparison: Unlike therapeutic agents, JAEGER is the forensic layer that decides what may leave the machine.
nlnet.challenges: Ensuring disclosure gate (PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json) correctly blocks raw primary docs and entity-resolution output.
nlnet.ecosystem: JAEGER + Nurse Ratchet (separate) + ELIZA = full investigation stack.
nlnet.experience: Team has built forensic investigation, code quality, and game engine tools.
nlnet.ai_prompt: Used AI for entity resolution patterns and disclosure gate logic.
